digest.component_or_area: graph link composition and library facade
propositions: When a cross-subtree blocking link escalates endpoints, the redirect record is printed to stdout but never returned, so library and MCP callers receive only 'ok' with no indication that different endpoints were recorded.
The stdout channel is suppressed by quiet=True in both the library facade and MCP tool, preventing callers from receiving the redirect record via any channel.
Five return-value drop points exist in the call chain from add_dependency through rebar.link to link_tickets, three of which were silently discarding the redirect record before the fix.
The quiet=True suppression cannot be removed because rebar-mcp speaks MCP-over-stdio and unsuppressed stdout would corrupt the JSON-RPC stream.
The redirect record must be returned as a value rather than communicated via stdout to reach library and MCP callers while preserving the quiet sink's load-bearing function.
